name: 1 John
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: Traditionally the apostle John.
setting: Written to believers troubled by false teaching.
theme: Walk in the light, love one another, and know that you have eternal life.

outline.label: That you may know that you have eternal life

christInBook: John begins with the word of life that we have heard, seen, and touched (1:1-4), says that Jesus Christ the righteous is our advocate (2:1), and says that God sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins (4:10).
howToRead: 1 John circles back to three themes: light and sin, righteousness and obedience, and love. Notice the tests of genuine faith: believing in Jesus, obeying his commands, and loving the brothers.
